## Run A: `112 101`

1. Run `git remote get-url origin`, which returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`.
2. Read the active pi-cohort configuration: `parallel.maxTasks` is 4. Admit the two distinct PRs in argument order, #112 then #101. Both belong to origin; there is no positional issue reference.
3. Create the parent run folder with `mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gate.XXXXXX"` and initialize its continuation record before progress tracking. Use the resulting absolute directory as `RUN_DIR`.
4. Run the parent gather command first for `112`, then for `101`:

   `gh pr view <N> --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`

   These return the supplied rows without changing their order.

5. Run `gh api user --jq .login`, returning `alex`.
6. Run `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'`, returning `acme/reviewers`.
7. Run `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD`. Against the returned default-branch ref, check the overrides in order with:
   - `git show <ref>:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show <ref>:gauntlet-overrides.md`
   - `git show <ref>:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`

   Stop that search at the first existing file. The supplied result establishes no tracker override. Both tickets can be displayed directly, so no Linear lookup runs.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved all three facts by having the parent render a pre-provisioning list as its own message: Run A prints `PRs to gate:` with linked entries in typed order (#112 +300 -80, by pat, linked issue #22; then #101 +3 -1, yours, issue #45 derived from the `gh-45-retry` branch), each with a short change phrase, no `discovered, smallest first:` line, and an explicit no-wait handoff to serial provisioning; Run B prints the singular `PR to gate:` with a linked #97, +40 -12, `by robin, requested from you`, `no ticket`, and a CSV-export phrase before any worktree is created. Before printed no list at all ('Messages the human sees: None'), so e1 and e3 failed, and e2 failed because there was no #112 entry reading `by pat`, even though Before did omit the discovered line and did not pause. Nothing Before held was lost. To keep this stable, keep the wording that explicitly ties the list to 'after gather, before provisioning', 'own message, no marker, no wait', typed order for explicit sets, and the rule that an author with no pending request renders as `by <login>` with no request wording; note that After now adds a viewer-login read, a team read, and override-path reads to the typed-set path that Before explicitly skipped, so if those extra reads are not intended for typed sets, state which of them the list entry actually requires.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: All three facts moved from fails to holds, and Before held none of them, so nothing was lost. Before closed each run with a prose sentence ("I will assess #112's shared settings resolver, then #101's...") with no heading, links, sizes, author or ticket. After instead prints `PRs to gate:` / `PR to gate:` with one linked entry per PR, in typed order for Run A (#112 before #101, not size-sorted), each carrying +/- counts, role wording, a linked ticket or `no ticket`, and a short change phrase. What made this possible is the wider parent gather (url, title, body, additions, deletions, closingIssuesReferences, reviewRequests) plus the viewer-login read, which give `by pat` with no request wording, `yours` for #101, and `requested from you` for #97. After also prints no `discovered, smallest first:` line and asks no question, going straight to naming provisioning as the next step; the "Stop before running it" text reads as the replay's stopping point, not a pause for the human. Two things to keep stable: issue #45 on #101 comes only from the branch name `gh-45-retry` (closing references are empty), so the wording should keep stating that a branch-derived ticket is linked like a closing reference; and the instruction to continue to provisioning without waiting should stay explicit so the list is never read as a confirmation prompt.
